payload.posture: Read Luke 24:13–35 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states two travelers recount recent events and the women’s report; Jesus interprets Scripture, is recognized at the meal, disappears, and they return. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
